summary.hr: Voće, med i cvijet — najgušća destilerijska dolina na svijetu.
summary.en: Fruit, honey and blossom — the densest distilling valley in the world.

body.hr:
Uz rijeku Spey stoji oko polovice svih škotskih destilerija, pa je Speyside prije gustoća nego stil. Ipak, kuća do kuće drži prepoznatljiv ton: jabuka, kruška, med i vanilija, rijetko treset.

DVIJE ŠKOLE
• Voćna — bourbon bačva, svijetlo i cvjetno (Glenlivet, Glenfiddich, Benriach).
• Sherry — oloroso i PX bačve, grožđice, smokva i tamna čokolada (Macallan, Glenfarclas, Aberlour).

UZ CIGARU
• Voćni Speyside traži blag pokrov — Connecticut Shade, corona ili panatela.
• Sherry Speyside podnese Habano i maduro; slatkoća bačve hvata papar i kavu iz dima.
body.en:
About half of Scotland's distilleries stand along the river Spey, so Speyside is density before it is a style. Even so, the houses share a recognisable tone: apple, pear, honey and vanilla, and rarely peat.

TWO SCHOOLS
• Fruity — bourbon casks, bright and floral (Glenlivet, Glenfiddich, Benriach).
• Sherry — oloroso and PX casks, raisin, fig and dark chocolate (Macallan, Glenfarclas, Aberlour).

WITH A CIGAR
• Fruity Speyside wants a mild wrapper — Connecticut Shade, a corona or a panatela.
• Sherry Speyside carries Habano and maduro; the cask sweetness catches the pepper and coffee in the smoke.

summary.hr: Najveća i najšarolikija regija — od laganog sjevera do punog zapada.
summary.en: The largest and most varied region — light in the north, full-bodied in the west.

body.hr:
Highlands je površinom golem i zato nema jedan okus; ima četiri kuta koja se međusobno ne liče.

ČETIRI KUTA
• Sjeverni — vrijesak, med i sol (Glenmorangie, Dalmore, Clynelish).
• Južni — lagano i suho, blizu Lowland tonu (Aberfeldy, Edradour).
• Istočni — čvrsto i žitno, često sherry (GlenDronach, Fettercairn).
• Zapadni — punije tijelo i dašak dima (Oban, Ben Nevis).

UZ CIGARU
• Sjeverni i južni Highland idu uz srednje tijelo — robusto s Ecuador ili Connecticut pokrovom.
• Zapadni i sherry-istočni nose i punu Nikaragvu.
body.en:
The Highlands is vast, so it has no single taste; it has four corners that do not resemble one another.

FOUR CORNERS
• Northern — heather, honey and salt (Glenmorangie, Dalmore, Clynelish).
• Southern — light and dry, close to the Lowland tone (Aberfeldy, Edradour).
• Eastern — firm and cereal-led, often sherried (GlenDronach, Fettercairn).
• Western — fuller body and a wisp of smoke (Oban, Ben Nevis).

WITH A CIGAR
• Northern and southern Highland suit a medium body — a robusto in an Ecuador or Connecticut wrapper.
• Western and sherried eastern bottlings carry full Nicaraguan blends too.

summary.hr: Treset, jod i morska sol — najprepoznatljiviji whisky na svijetu.
summary.en: Peat, iodine and sea salt — the most recognisable whisky in the world.

body.hr:
Islay je otok od tresetišta i vjetra. Ječam se suši nad tresetnom vatrom, dim uđe u zrno i ostane do čaše — mjeri se u ppm fenola, a bačva ga s godinama pripitomi, ali ne izbriše.

TRI JAČINE
• Južna obala — najdimnije, medicinsko i slano (Ardbeg, Lagavulin, Laphroaig).
• Sredina i sjever — blaži dim uz voće (Bowmore, Caol Ila; Bunnahabhain često i bez treseta).
• Nove kuće — Kilchoman i Bruichladdich voze cijeli raspon, od nedimljenog do vrlo visokih ppm vrijednosti.

UZ CIGARU
• Dim uz dim radi samo kad je cigara dovoljno jaka — maduro, oscuro, puna Nikaragva.
• Nježan Connecticut Shade Islay pregazi; ostavi ga za kraj večeri, ne za početak.
body.en:
Islay is an island of peat bog and wind. The barley is dried over a peat fire, the smoke enters the grain and stays there all the way to the glass — it is measured in ppm of phenols, and years in cask tame it without erasing it.

THREE INTENSITIES
• South shore — the smokiest, medicinal and saline (Ardbeg, Lagavulin, Laphroaig).
• Centre and north — gentler smoke over fruit (Bowmore, Caol Ila; Bunnahabhain often unpeated).
• Newer houses — Kilchoman and Bruichladdich run the whole range, from unpeated to very high ppm.

WITH A CIGAR
• Smoke on smoke only works when the cigar is strong enough — maduro, oscuro, full Nicaraguan.
• A delicate Connecticut Shade is flattened by Islay; save it for the end of the evening, not the start.

summary.hr: Orkney, Skye, Jura, Arran — sol i dim, svaki otok svojim tempom.
summary.en: Orkney, Skye, Jura, Arran — salt and smoke, each island at its own pace.

body.hr:
Službeno Otoci nisu zasebna regija — Scotch Whisky Regulations ih broje pod Highlands. U praksi se izdvajaju jer dijele morski ton koji kopno nema, pa ih tako vodi i ovaj katalog.

OTOK PO OTOK
• Orkney — vrijesak i suhi dim (Highland Park), uz nedimljenu stranu (Scapa).
• Skye — papar, sol i dim u istoj čaši (Talisker).
• Jura, Arran, Mull — od voćnog do dimljenog, ovisno o izdanju.

UZ CIGARU
• Slani ton lijepo veže s maduro pokrovom i kavom iz dima.
• Srednji otočni dim je najsigurniji most kad Islay djeluje prejako.
body.en:
Officially the Islands are not a region of their own — the Scotch Whisky Regulations count them under the Highlands. In practice they are set apart because they share a maritime tone the mainland lacks, and this catalogue follows that usage.

ISLAND BY ISLAND
• Orkney — heather and dry smoke (Highland Park), alongside an unpeated side (Scapa).
• Skye — pepper, salt and smoke in one glass (Talisker).
• Jura, Arran, Mull — fruity through smoky, depending on the release.

WITH A CIGAR
• The saline tone binds well with a maduro wrapper and the coffee note in the smoke.
• Moderate island smoke is the safest bridge when Islay feels like too much.

summary.hr: Lagano, travnato i suho — klasičan aperitiv, često trostruko destilirano.
summary.en: Light, grassy and dry — the classic aperitif, often triple distilled.

body.hr:
Lowlands leži južno od crte Greenock–Dundee. Dugo je bio regija u opadanju, a danas ga nove destilerije vraćaju. Tradicija je trostruka destilacija, koja daje lakši i čišći destilat.

ŠTO OČEKIVATI
• Trava, limun, sijeno i keks; rijetko treset.
• Niže tijelo od Speysidea, pa se pije mlađi i hladniji.
• Kuće — Auchentoshan, Glenkinchie, Bladnoch, Daftmill.

UZ CIGARU
• Traži najblaži kraj police: Connecticut Shade, panatela, lancero.
• Uz punu cigaru nestane — Lowland je piće prve trećine večeri, ne zadnje.
body.en:
The Lowlands lie south of the Greenock–Dundee line. For a long time the region was in decline; new distilleries are bringing it back. The tradition here is triple distillation, which yields a lighter, cleaner spirit.

WHAT TO EXPECT
• Grass, lemon, hay and biscuit; peat is rare.
• Lower body than Speyside, so it is drunk younger and cooler.
• Houses — Auchentoshan, Glenkinchie, Bladnoch, Daftmill.

WITH A CIGAR
• It wants the mildest end of the shelf: Connecticut Shade, a panatela, a lancero.
• A full cigar erases it — Lowland belongs to the first third of the evening, not the last.

summary.hr: Tri destilerije, jedan grad — sol, ulje i voće u istoj čaši.
summary.en: Three distilleries, one town — salt, oil and fruit in the same glass.

body.hr:
Campbeltown je nekad imao preko trideset destilerija i zvao se glavnim gradom whiskyja. Danas ih ima tri (Springbank, Glen Scotia, Glengyle/Kilkerran), a status regije zadržao je jer je stil doista svoj.

POTPIS
• Slano-uljasta tekstura, voće i blagi dim — sve odjednom.
• Springbank i dalje sve radi u vlastitoj kući, od slada do boce.
• Male serije, pa cijene i dostupnost skaču.

UZ CIGARU
• Uljasta tekstura podnosi punije cigare bez da ih pregazi.
• Odličan srednji put kad je Islay prejak, a Speyside preslab.
body.en:
Campbeltown once held more than thirty distilleries and called itself the whisky capital of the world. Three remain (Springbank, Glen Scotia, Glengyle/Kilkerran), and it kept its regional status because the style really is its own.

SIGNATURE
• A salty, oily texture with fruit and light smoke — all at once.
• Springbank still does everything in house, from malting to bottling.
• Small batches, so prices and availability swing.

WITH A CIGAR
• The oily texture stands up to fuller cigars without being flattened.
• An excellent middle path when Islay is too much and Speyside too little.

note.hr: Speyside iz bourbon bačve: jabuka, kruška, med i vanilija, bez treseta.
note.en: Speyside from a bourbon cask: apple, pear, honey and vanilla, no peat.

note.hr: Speyside dozrio u oloroso ili PX bačvi, pa nosi grožđice, smokvu i tamnu čokoladu.
note.en: Speyside matured in oloroso or PX casks, carrying raisin, fig and dark chocolate.

note.hr: Ječam sušen nad tresetom daje dim, jod i sol; jačina se mjeri u ppm fenola.
note.en: Barley dried over peat gives smoke, iodine and salt; intensity is measured in ppm of phenols.

note.hr: Otočni malt izvan Islaya: morska sol i blaži dim (Orkney, Skye, Jura, Arran).
note.en: Island malt outside Islay: sea salt and gentler smoke (Orkney, Skye, Jura, Arran).

note.hr: Najšira polica: vrijesak i med na sjeveru, punije tijelo i dašak dima na zapadu.
note.en: The widest shelf: heather and honey in the north, fuller body and a wisp of smoke in the west.

note.hr: Često trostruko destiliran, pa je najlakši škotski stil: trava, limun i sijeno.
note.en: Often triple distilled, the lightest Scottish style: grass, lemon and hay.

note.hr: Slano-uljasta tekstura s voćem i blagim dimom; u gradu su ostale tri destilerije.
note.en: A salty, oily texture with fruit and light smoke; three distilleries remain in the town.

note.hr: Mješavina sladnog i žitnog whiskyja: žitni dio daje mekoću, sladni karakter.
note.en: A blend of malt and grain whisky: grain brings softness, malt brings character.

note.hr: Najmanje 51 % kukuruza i nova opaljena hrastova bačva: vanilija, karamela i kokos.
note.en: At least 51% corn and new charred oak: vanilla, caramel and coconut.

note.hr: Bourbon recept plus Lincoln County Process, filtriranje kroz javorov ugljen prije bačve.
note.en: A bourbon recipe plus the Lincoln County Process, maple charcoal filtering before the cask.

note.hr: Najmanje 51 % raži donosi papar, kopar i suhi začin; prirodan most prema Habano cigari.
note.en: At least 51% rye brings pepper, dill and dry spice; a natural bridge to a Habano cigar.

note.hr: Irski specijalitet od sladnog i nesladnog ječma u pot stillu: kremasto, uljasto, začinjeno.
note.en: The Irish speciality of malted and unmalted barley in a pot still: creamy, oily, spicy.

note.hr: Sladni ječam iz jedne irske destilerije, najčešće trostruko destiliran i bez treseta.
note.en: Malted barley from a single Irish distillery, usually triple distilled and unpeated.

note.hr: Mješavina pot still, sladnog i žitnog whiskyja; najmekši i najpitkiji irski stil.
note.en: A blend of pot still, malt and grain whiskey; the softest, easiest-drinking Irish style.

note.hr: Škotski postupak s japanskom preciznošću; mizunara hrast dodaje tamjan i sandalovinu.
note.en: Scottish method with Japanese precision; mizunara oak adds incense and sandalwood.

note.hr: Whisky izvan klasičnih zemalja; Tajvan, Indija i Australija u toplini zriju znatno brže.
note.en: Whisky beyond the classic countries; Taiwan, India and Australia mature far faster in the heat.

note.hr: Liker na bazi whiskyja s medom, biljem i šećerom; slađi i slabiji od destilata.
note.en: A whisky-based liqueur with honey, herbs and sugar; sweeter and weaker than the spirit.
